books.title: Lavengro
books.author: George Borrow
books.summary: A young man with a passion for learning languages is befriended by a group of gypsies and travels Britain, encountering a variety of interesting characters.

books.title: Waverley
books.author: Walter Scott
books.summary: A young English officer becomes involved in the Jacobite rebellion.

books.title: A Yankee in the Trenches
books.author: Robert Derby Holmes
books.summary: An American describes his experiences in the British Army in the First World War.

books.title: Tombstone
books.author: Walter Noble Burns
books.summary: An embellished retelling of the town of Tombstone, Arizona, during its heyday in the late 19th century, featuring famous heroes and outlaws of the American Old West.

books.title: Just So Stories
books.author: Rudyard Kipling
books.summary: A collection of short humorous fables for children, most purporting to tell the origin of animal characteristics such as the camel’s hump.

books.title: The Cords of Vanity
books.author: James Branch Cabell
books.summary: An arrogant young author makes his way through a series of love affairs, avoiding every situation that may cause unpleasantness.

books.title: Saint Joan
books.author: George Bernard Shaw
books.summary: Joan of Arc’s life story is retold, from her early life, to her campaigns, and beyond.

books.title: The Sketchbook of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent.
books.author: Washington Irving
books.summary: A collection of 34 essays and short stories, including “The Legend of Sleepy Hollow” and “Rip Van Winkle.”

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Thomas Hardy
books.summary: A collection of Thomas Hardy’s short stories, mostly ordered by date of publication.

books.title: The Necromancers
books.author: Robert Hugh Benson
books.summary: A young woman watches with concern as her adopted brother turns to irreligious forces in the hopes of reconnecting with his dead fiancée.

books.title: Sailing Alone Around the World
books.author: Joshua Slocum
books.summary: A sailor gives his account how he completed the first solo sailing voyage around the world.

books.title: The Viaduct Murder
books.author: Ronald A. Knox
books.summary: A foursome of friends out golfing try to unravel the mystery surrounding a corpse found on the links.

books.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
books.author: Benjamin Franklin
books.summary: Benjamin Franklin writes about his youth, adventures, and achievements.

books.title: The Age of Reason
books.author: Thomas Paine
books.summary: Paine argues against the legitimacy of the Bible and institutional religion.

books.title: The Eclogues
books.author: Virgil
books.summary: Ten pastoral poems exploring themes of love, politics, and the impact of war.

books.title: The History of Rasselas, Prince of Abyssinia
books.author: Samuel Johnson
books.summary: An Abyssinian prince embarks on adventures while exploring the meaning of happiness.

books.title: Storm Over Warlock
books.author: Andre Norton
books.summary: On a planet presumed devoid of intelligent life, and in a race to colonize worlds ahead of brutal beetle-like aliens, two surveyors take flight from their hunters and try to uncover the secrets of a place that seems ever less benign.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.summary: A collection of short fiction by Mary Shelley, ordered by date of publication.

books.title: The Protestant Ethic and the Spirit of Capitalism
books.author: Max Weber
books.summary: A German historian presents a theory detailing how certain ideas which are key to capitalism may have evolved from Protestantism.

books.title: South!
books.author: Ernest Shackleton
books.summary: A British expedition sets off to cross Antarctica, but when their ship is wrecked they have to face a long struggle for survival.
